title: 紐西蘭 HVDC Inter-Island 連線案例
titleEn: New Zealand HVDC Inter-Island link case study
summary: 以 4 階段、24 項作業探究南北島能源互補與資產更新；每個技術單元分為模型與判別，包含計算、失效機制、可保存的工程證據與知識測驗。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages investigate island energy complementarity and asset renewal. Each technical unit pairs modeling with diagnosis, calculations, failure mechanisms, saveable evidence and a knowledge check.
scope: 公開原理與案例資料判讀課。教學示意、算例和操作是工程模型，不是供應商配方、現場施工或帶電操作程序；實際設計須由合格專業人員依適用標準與實測條件審查。
scopeEn: Public-principle and case-data interpretation course. Diagrams, examples and operations are engineering models, not vendor recipes, construction instructions or energized procedures. Actual design needs qualified review against applicable standards and measured conditions.

workedExample.title: 可重算的工程算例
workedExample.text: 教學某島需額外 300 MW 持續 4 小時，缺口 1.2 GWh；互聯是否可補足還取決於對端餘裕與剩餘容量。
workedExample.textEn: If an island hypothetically needs an extra 300 MW for 4 hours, the gap is 1.2 GWh; filling it also requires exporting-island surplus and available link capacity.
workedExample.assumptions: 完全是假想調度練習，並非紐西蘭電網當前負載、備援或操作指令。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Entirely hypothetical dispatch exercise, not current New Zealand load, reserve or operating instructions.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行設定的假想算例；來源支援原理，不提供此組假想輸入。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently chosen hypothetical inputs; references support principles, not these assumed inputs.
